Yes. Everything you enter is saved on the phone first, so logging a service, adding a document or checking your costs all work with no signal. When you are back online it syncs in the background.
How does Odo update my odometer on its own?

Once you enrol your car, Odo notices when you start driving and adds the distance to your odometer. It uses your car's Bluetooth stereo, where you have one, to tell your drives apart from other journeys. You can always correct the reading by hand.
Why does Odo ask for location in the background?
Only to measure a drive after the screen goes off. Without it a trip stops being counted the moment you put the phone down. You can skip it and log distance yourself.
Do my trips leave my phone?
No. Trip points stay on the device and are never uploaded. Only the distance is used, and you can turn off keeping them at all in Profile, under Privacy.
You photograph the bill and Odo reads the text on the device itself. It fills in the workshop, date, line items and total for you to check before saving.
What is my bill compared against?

Prices other owners have paid for the same work in your city, anonymised. Nothing that identifies you, your car or your workshop is ever part of it, and you can turn sharing off in Profile, under Privacy.
Why does a fairness check say it has no data?
A benchmark only appears once enough owners have logged the same job in your city. Until then Odo would rather say nothing than compare your bill against a number it cannot stand behind.
A read on how well the car is being kept, built from what you have actually recorded — services logged, documents that are current, and how complete your history is. It moves as you record more.
Will Odo warn me before my insurance or PUC runs out?
Yes. Add the document with its expiry date and Odo notifies you ahead of time. How many days' notice you get is yours to set in Profile, under Notifications.
Unlimited bill scans, an unlimited document vault, the full Health Score breakdown, and your complete record as a printable PDF. Logging services, fills and documents stays free.
Can I keep more than one car in Odo?
Not yet. Odo holds one car at a time today.
How do I delete my account and everything in it?
Profile, then Privacy, then Delete my account and data. It erases your record rather than hiding it, so it cannot be undone.
